syntheticEndings.samplePlanNote: Remaining30/20-second cases bounded to1000 before any ending result was inspected; no outcome-dependent stopping. Identical seed ranges within each paired case.
syntheticEndings.endpoint: Tied60 and tied30 use completed full-resolver runs. Tied20 stops the production regulation resolver at the buzzer; equality defines OT entry under unchanged engine rule. 100 paired tied30 samples per arm verify exact endpoint/full-resolver equality.

interpretation: Reset samples vary game seeds/matchups within one generated universe; not full season or independent league samples. Seed pairing stops assuring identical RNG after a branch diverges. NBA timing explicitly verifies identical scores at60. No forced outcomes or accuracy changes.
